$comment: Component-derived contrast debt ledger, landed by RAIL-COMPONENT-CONTRAST-01. Two-directional ratchet: a failing pair NOT listed here fails generate:check, and an entry that no longer reproduces a failing pair fails as stale (delete it when fixed). fg/bg are terminal identities — a global token path or a literal hex — exactly as derived by component-contrast.ts. Entries match per (component, fg, bg) across themes, scopes, and blocks. This ledger can only shrink truthfully. BURNED TO EMPTY by FIX-CONTRAST-DEBT-01: resolver alpha preservation (core.color.mode.transparent resolves to #00000000), theme-aware semantic.interaction.text.hover, brightened foreground.hover dark, and darkened foreground.secondary light made all six original entries stop reproducing — the ratchet demanded each removal, which is the proof of the burn. REGROWN (truthfully) by RAIL-COMPONENT-CONTRAST-ANCESTRY-01: the inheritance-aware pairing lens derives pairs that were previously unmodeled (CodeBlock token-span palette, Select emptyState); the failing ones are ledgered here pending a palette-repair token-source slice. The ratchet still only shrinks per entry — each removal still requires its pair to stop failing.
